author: J. W. Clark
title: Covington issues state of emergency as winter weather disrupts services
text:
The City of Covington has declared a State of Emergency as severe winter weather continues to affect the area. City Hall is operating with limited services on Monday, January 26, and is also open as a warming center for residents needing shelter from the cold.
To help during snow removal, the city has made its parking lots and garages available for free until 10:00 a.m. Tuesday. Residents who have already received or paid parking fees can request reimbursement at City Hall.
Trash and recycling services provided by Rumpke are suspended for Monday in Kenton County due to hazardous conditions. Service will resume with a one-day delay for the rest of the week, depending on road safety.
City officials expressed gratitude toward Public Works crews, police officers, firefighters, and all first responders managing emergencies throughout the storm. The public is advised to remain cautious and follow official city channels for ongoing updates.
